rationale: C22 is the closest candidate because both letters urge congressional committees to support legislation or funding for a major water-and-power construction project, and both close by requesting favorable action from the committee and Congress. C24 similarly advocates congressional authorization of a multipurpose water, navigation, and power project, while C10 refers to prior recommendations and asks relevant committees to develop legislation. These similarities, however, consist of broad subject matter and conventional legislative-advocacy structure. None reproduces the child's distinctive account of an earlier presidential message, unfinished action in the prior Congress, pending bills accomplishing the same purposes, and the specific transfer and expansion of project responsibilities. The evidence therefore does not establish a concrete, material drafting template.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hope that your Committee and the Congress will act favorably on legislation to carry out these recommendations.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I urge, in the strongest possible terms, the favorable consideration of your Committee and of the Congress.
shared_material.explanation: C22 has the closest closing formulation, but this is routine language requesting favorable congressional action.
